C1794.title: Neijiang Police Crack Down on Order Decryption Case Involving Infringement of Citizens' Personal Information
C1794.summary: The Shizhong District Branch of the Neijiang Public Security Bureau uncovered a major case involving the infringement of citizens' personal information, where a criminal gang illegally obtained and sold e-commerce platform user data through order decryption methods. Police arrested six suspects, seized over 2 million leaked order records, and identified illicit proceeds exceeding 8 million yuan. T
